description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'LoggerAppender' which serves as a base for different logging appender implementations within the log4php logging framework. It includes methods for creating singleton and factory instances, managing filters, layout, and error handling, but leaves most implementation details to subclasses.

classes.name: LoggerAppender
classes.description: An abstract class defining the basic interface and common methods for log4php appender classes, which handle how logging events are output.

methods.name: singleton
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of an appender with the specified name and class.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a new filter to the appender's filter chain.

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.description: Removes all filters from the appender.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns the first filter in the filter chain, or null if none is set.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases any resources held by the appender; should be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: doAppend
methods.description: Performs threshold checks, applies filters, and delegates logging to subclass-specific append method.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Gets the name of the appender.

methods.name: setErrorHandler
methods.description: Sets an error handler object for the appender.

methods.name: getErrorHandler
methods.description: Returns the current error handler associated with the appender.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Assigns a layout to structure log messages.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Returns the layout assigned to this appender.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the appender.

methods.name: requiresLayout
methods.description: Indicates if the appender requires a layout for formatting logs.
